mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file ( name, org_name, path, file_size, file_extension, created_at ) VALUES ( #{storedFileName}, #{originalFileName}, #{s3Key}, #{fileSize}, #{fileExtension}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
INSERT INTO file_attachments ( file_id, ref_type, ref_id, attached_at, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{fileId}, #{refType}, #{refId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE file_attachments SET ref_type = #{refType}, ref_id = #{refId}, is_deleted = #{isDeleted} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE file_attachments SET is_deleted = '1' WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
mapper.select: SELECT fa.id as id, fa.file_id as fileId, fa.ref_type as refType, fa.ref_id as refId, fa.attached_at as attachedAt, fa.is_deleted as isDeleted, f.name as storedFileName, f.org_name as originalFileName, f.path as s3Key, -- 파일 확장자 추출 (원본 파일명에서) CASE WHEN f.org_name IS NOT NULL AND LOCATE('.', f.org_name) > 0 THEN LOWER(SUBSTRING(f.org_name, LOCATE('.', f.org_name) + 1)) ELSE '' END as fileExtension, -- 파일 크기 (실제 컬럼에서 가져오기) COALESCE(f.file_size, '0') as fileSize, -- S3 버킷은 설정에서 가져오므로 빈 값으로 설정 '' as s3Bucket, f.created_at as createdAt FROM file_attachments fa INNER JOIN file f ON fa.file_id = f.id WHERE fa.file_id = #{fileId} AND fa.is_deleted = '0'

SELECT fa.id as id, fa.file_id as fileId, fa.ref_type as refType, fa.ref_id as refId, fa.attached_at as attachedAt, fa.is_deleted as isDeleted, f.name as storedFileName, f.org_name as originalFileName, f.path as s3Key, -- 파일 확장자 추출 CASE WHEN f.org_name IS NOT NULL AND LOCATE('.', f.org_name) > 0 THEN LOWER(SUBSTRING(f.org_name, LOCATE('.', f.org_name) + 1)) ELSE '' END as fileExtension, -- 파일 크기 COALESCE(f.file_size, '0') as fileSize, -- S3 버킷 '' as s3Bucket, f.created_at as createdAt FROM file_attachments fa INNER JOIN file f ON fa.file_id = f.id WHERE fa.ref_type = #{refType} AND fa.ref_id = #{refId} AND fa.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY fa.attached_at DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE fa, f FROM file_attachments fa INNER JOIN file f ON fa.file_id = f.id WHERE fa.ref_type = 'TEMP_UPLOAD' AND fa.ref_id LIKE CONCAT(#{tempRefId}, '%')
DELETE f, fa FROM file f LEFT JOIN file_attachments fa ON f.id = fa.file_id WHERE f.id = #{fileId}
